corrections.reason: The word is 'አንገድ' (tribe/clan, glossing ሕዝብ), printed with 1st-order 'ገ' rather than 4th-order 'ጋ'.
The Amharic compound 'አጅ ግርግርታ' (retinue/crowd commotion) is printed with 6th-order 'ጅ' ('አጅ').
The image clearly shows the 4-character word 'ሰጥተውት' (having given him), matching Col 3 L02; 'ጥተ' was compressed into 'ጠ' in Stage 1.
In the standard Andemta gloss of 'እንተ ትፀብአ ለነፍስክሙ', the flesh's desire makes the body a helper/ally ('ሥጋችሁን ረዳት አድርጋ') to wage war against the soul. Visually, 'ረዳት' was misread as 'ጸብት'.
The printed text has the authentic 4-character archaic Andemta form 'እንደኒህ' (not 'እንደነዚህ').
